encounter_slots_result_winner_check.name: encounter_slots_result_winner_check
encounter_slots_result_winner_check.value: "encounter_slots"."result_type" is null or "encounter_slots"."winner_side" is not null

tournament_matches_result_type_consisten.name: tournament_matches_result_type_consistency
tournament_matches_result_type_consisten.value: ("tournament_matches"."status" = 'COMPLETED' and "tournament_matches"."result_type" is not null and "tournament_matches"."result_type" in ('PLAYED', 'WALKOVER')) or ("tournament_matches"."status" = 'BYE' and "tournament_matches"."result_type" is not null and "tournament_matches"."result_type" = 'BYE') or ("tournament_matches"."status" not in ('COMPLETED', 'BYE') and "tournament_matches"."result_type" is null)

tournament_matches_participants_differen.name: tournament_matches_participants_different
tournament_matches_participants_differen.value: "tournament_matches"."participant_one_id" is null or "tournament_matches"."participant_two_id" is null or "tournament_matches"."participant_one_id" <> "tournament_matches"."participant_two_id"

tournament_participants_withdrawal_check.name: tournament_participants_withdrawal_check
tournament_participants_withdrawal_check.value: ("tournament_participants"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "tournament_participants"."withdrawn_at" is null and "tournament_participants"."withdrawal_reason" is null) or ("tournament_participants"."status" = 'WITHDRAWN' and "tournament_participants"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "tournament_participants"."withdrawal_reason" is not null and length(trim("tournament_participants"."withdrawal_reason")) between 3 and 500)

visits_checkout_double_check.name: visits_checkout_double_check
visits_checkout_double_check.value: "visits"."checkout_double" is null or "visits"."checkout_double" between 1 and 20 or "visits"."checkout_double" = 25
